app/(dashboard)/products/page.tsx.description: Products page with complex CRUD operations, price ledger integration (immutable), search/filter functionality, and ProductListItem sub-component. Includes three files: main list page, new product page, and edit product page.

app/(dashboard)/categories/page.tsx.description: Categories page with hierarchical tree structure using recursive CategoryTreeNode component. Includes Turkish slug generation, parent-child relationship management, and prevents circular dependencies.

app/(dashboard)/tables/page.tsx.description: Tables page with QR code generation for restaurant tables. Supports multiple QR formats (SVG/PNG/PDF), table status management (empty/occupied/service_needed), and statistics display. Uses TableListItem sub-component.

app/(admin)/admin/plans/page.tsx.description: Plans management page (admin-only) with dynamic plan-feature system. Supports feature catalog with boolean/limit types, plan-feature assignments, and subscriber tracking. Uses tab-based UI for plans and features.
